title: Why Is the Sun Getting Brighter as It Runs Out of Fuel?
description:
Is the Sun Getting Brighter?

Credits:
SVS 13778: NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center / SDO (https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/13778)

social.hook: The Sun is running out of fuel, and it's getting brighter because of it.
social.question: Did you know the Sun was brighter today than when the dinosaurs lived?
social.alt: The Sun's disc with a prominence lifting off its edge, captioned IT'S BRIGHTER.
